title: Shi Kun Falls
summary: Shi Kun's group reaches the Eight Extremes Sect gate, where Little Flame stands guard alone and is badly beaten. Inside, Lin Dong survives the remnant master's final move with Little Mink's help. He comes out having learned the spiritual martial art Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand. He overpowers Shi Kun and kills him with it, then takes his Ancient Secret Key. Little Mink heals Little Flame with pills from Lin Dong's Qiankun Bag. The Ancient Keys then point the way to the Four Sect Halls, where every dynasty gathers before bronze gates. Lin Langtian, Hong Lie and You Qing accuse Lin Dong of theft and murder and demand his two keys and the pill. Lin Dong refuses and dares Lin Langtian to fight him one on one.
events: Shi Kun's men attack Little Flame, who refuses to let anyone through the gate.
Lin Dong takes the remnant master's last move and masters the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand.
Lin Dong overwhelms Shi Kun and kills him.
Little Mink heals Little Flame with pills from the Qiankun Bag.
The Ancient Keys lead everyone to the bronze gates of the Four Sect Halls.
The gates react to Lin Dong's two keys; Lin Langtian, Hong Lie and You Qing demand them.
Lin Dong refuses and challenges Lin Langtian to fight alone.
cultivation: Lin Dong gains the spiritual martial art Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand. Shi Kun was at the peak of Two Yuan Nirvana when Lin Dong killed him.
